propositions: A mixed-provider fallback chain disables prompt caching because provider-specific cache keys do not intersect across providers.
runner_support._intersect_capabilities collapses disagreeing prompt_cache_style values to 'none' when building a fallback chain's capability record.
An operator observing zero cache read and zero cache write tokens on a chain-backed operation may incorrectly conclude caching regressed, despite the same model caching normally when called directly.
docs/llm-framework.md's accounting section lacks documentation explaining why mixed-provider chains report zero cache metrics despite individual providers supporting caching.
The accounting section must explicitly state that a fallback chain resolves to no prompt caching and reference runner_support._intersect_capabilities as the implementation authority.
